job.question: In the Los Angeles City Employees' Retirement System (LACERS) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the lead actuary have?
job.expected_facts: At least 15 years of experience with major public employee retirement systems, including at least 3 years with California public pension fund clients similar to LACERS.
job.acceptance: Accept 15 total and three California years. Do not require credential details unrelated to the years asked.

reviews.reason: This is a City of Hartford RFP for a general investment consultant, not a LACERS actuarial RFP. Its experience requirement concerns a primary investment consultant and does not establish the lead actuary requirement asked about.
quotes: CITY OF HARTFORD TREASURER’S OFFICE MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES’ RETIREMENT FUND of the CITY of HARTFORD and CITY of HARTFORD OPEB TRUST
REQUEST FOR PROPOSALS (“RFP”) GENERAL INVESTMENT CONSULTANT

The primary consultant assigned to the MERF and OPEB relationship shall have a minimum of five (5) years of consulting experience with defined benefit public pension plans and have been employed by the Proposer for at least three (3) years.
